summary: issue-517-render-branch-wiring: production wiring for persistent BranchContentStore, JournaledRuntimePublish, synvelis.render.* gateway registration, VCS-RESTORE-10 fork-copy (synvelis#517)

E1: DirectoryBranchContentStore uses <root>/<sha256-hex> one-file-per-digest with StagedFile+CreateNew+FileAndDirectorySync; CreateNew race resolved by readback digest verification (content addressing makes same-name-different-bytes impossible for honest writers).

E2: JournaledRuntimePublish always reports typed Pending (never Published) — no live runtime exists inside synvelis-project to confirm activation; journal write failure reports typed Failed. RCP-BR-04 last-good contract preserved.

E3: per-op required_permissions/data_access on CapabilityDescriptor are declarative metadata, not enforced grant dimensions — the enforced floors are wire-capability permissions + capability list + scoped resource effects (identical machinery for branch and render ops). Test adjusted to pin the real floors.

E4: same idempotency_key + same payload apply -> GatewayError::DuplicateRequest (determined replay, no second effect); same key + different payload -> IdempotencyConflict. Render ops share the branch-op idempotency machinery.

E5: restore fork-copy materializes every Captured payload_digest into dest branch-content/<hex> digest-verified; receipt.branch_content recomputes copied from published dest; absent source/port -> unavailable list (honest CandidateUnavailable verdict), transport/digest failures abort the restore.
cargo test (auxiliary evidence): synvelis-project --test sv517_render_wiring 6/6 pass; synvelis-gateway --test sv517_render_actions 6/6 pass. mise canonical verification pending at PR time.
